sql: SELECT 'regra_usa_robo_antigo' AS item, (position('proximo_passo' in pg_get_functiondef('public.recalculate_lead_score(uuid)'::regprocedure)) > 0)::text AS valor UNION ALL SELECT 'temperatura_leads_30d_castelo', string_agg(t || ':' || n, ' ' ORDER BY n DESC) FROM (SELECT li.temperature AS t, count(*) AS n FROM lead_intelligence li JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = li.lead_id WHERE l.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND l.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1) a UNION ALL SELECT 'leads_30d_sem_pontuacao', count(*)::text FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND l.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_intelligence li WHERE li.lead_id = l.id) UNION ALL SELECT 'snapshots_30d', count(*)::text FROM lead_score_snapshots WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND snapshot_date >= (now() - interval '30 days')::date
